preconditions.description: The input string tiles must have a length between 1 and 7 inclusive.
Each character in tiles must be an uppercase English letter.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for sequence in generate_sequences(tiles) if sequence)
postconditions.description: The return value equals the count of all possible non-empty sequences that can be formed by rearranging the letters in tiles, where sequences are formed by selecting any subset of letters (with multiplicity) and permuting them.
